title: A Unified Backbone--Expert Framework with Relation-Token and Residual--Classifier Interfaces for Automatic Modulation Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2608.15160v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic modulation recognition (AMR) faces distinct representation bottlenecks under varying observation lengths, where a single model architecture often fails to excel. To address this, we propose a unified backbone-expert framework with a common convolutional state-space backbone and two specialized interfaces. For short sequences, we inject explicit lag-aware complex-plane descriptors as relation tokens before encoding to compensate for information loss. For long sequences, we design a gated multi-scale residual refinement module to correct the feature map, combined with a fixed-averaging classifier collaboration to harness complementary evidence. Our framework achieves overall average accuracies of 67.28 \pm 0.14% on RML2016.10b and 87.19 \pm 0.77% on HisarMod2019 (mean \pm sample standard deviation over three runs), respectively. The framework's efficacy is further validated through three-seed ablations, native-length cross-conf

translated_title: 一种统一的主干-专家框架，结合关系令牌与残差分类器接口，用于自动调制识别
translated_abstract: 自动调制识别（AMR）在不同观测长度下面临不同的表示瓶颈，单一模型架构往往难以在所有情况下表现出色。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种统一的主干-专家框架，包含一个通用的卷积状态空间主干和两个专门接口。对于短序列，我们在编码前注入显式的滞后感知复平面描述符作为关系令牌，以补偿信息损失。对于长序列，我们设计了一个门控多尺度残差细化模块来修正特征图，并结合固定平均分类器协作以利用互补证据。我们的框架在RML2016.10b上实现了67.28 ± 0.14%的整体平均准确率，在HisarMod2019上实现了87.19 ± 0.77%（三次运行的平均值 ± 样本标准差）。框架的有效性通过三种子消融实验和原生长度交叉验证进一步得到验证。
tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的主干-专家框架，通过关系令牌和残差分类器接口分别处理短序列和长序列的表示瓶颈，显著提升了自动调制识别的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified backbone-expert framework with relation-token and residual-classifier interfaces to address representation bottlenecks in automatic modulation recognition under varying observation lengths, significantly improving accuracy.
